items.title: A 737 MAX Software Glitch Gives Boeing Investors a Fresh Headache
items.summary: Boeing  investors face a fresh problem with the company’s troubled 737 MAX jet—which could prompt volatile trading in shares this coming week.  Saturday, The Wall Street Journal reported a MAX software glitch that can affect landing after an initial missed approach.  Boeing notified airlines of the problem in late August.

items.title: Boeing finds 737 MAX software glitch that may affect automated navigation - WSJ
items.summary: Investing.com -- Boeing (NYSE:BA) has identified a software glitch on its 737 MAX that can disable an automated navigation function during a landing after a missed approach, raising concerns among industry officials and prompting a review by U.S. regulators, The Wall Street Journal reported on Saturday.

items.title: New Boeing 737 MAX Software Glitch Could Disrupt Navigation Feature
items.summary: The issue is prompting concerns about a potential safety risk while planes are landing. Boeing is working on a procedure for pilots and a software fix.

items.title: PPA Is a One-Ticker Bet on Rising Defense Spending. Nearly 30% of Holdings Are in Just Four Stocks
items.summary: Defense budgets are soaring on both sides of the Atlantic, and one ETF promises to capture the entire boom in a single trade. But a closer look at what you actually own when you buy it reveals a far more concentrated story than the 63-stock lineup suggests.

items.title: Boeing (BA) Is Considered a Good Investment by Brokers: Is That True?
items.summary: According to the average brokerage recommendation (ABR), one should invest in Boeing (BA). It is debatable whether this highly sought-after metric is effective because Wall Street analysts' recommendations tend to be overly optimistic. Would it be worth investing in the stock?
